versions.content: Semantics of attribute DiagnosticAbstractParameter . parameterSize The attribute DiagnosticAbstractParameter . parameter- Size can be used to indicate the size of the current DiagnosticAbstractParam- eter in the unit bits . This information is relevant if the following DiagnosticAbstractParameter (or the end of the telegram) is not placed directly adjacent to the current DiagnosticAb- stractParameter , i.e. gaps exist between two adjacent DiagnosticAbstract- Parameter s.
